name: whatsapp-ai-sales-assistant-v1
description: WhatsApp AI sales assistant V1 prototype for cross-border ecommerce sales teams.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @wa-ai/shared && concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wa-ai/shared && npm run build -w @wa-ai/api && npm run build -w @wa-ai/web && npm run build -w @wa-ai/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wa-ai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @wa-ai/api && npm run typecheck -w @wa-ai/web && npm run typecheck -w @wa-ai/extension
scripts.db:init: npm run db:up && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate -- --name init && npm run db:seed
